sources.title: Getting started with prompts for GitHub Copilot Chat in your IDE
Get started with Copilot agents on GitHub
Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile

claims.text: GitHub documents Copilot Chat workflows for fixing and refactoring code and for writing tests from active code or explicit test requirements, supporting the candidate's use of code/test generation as bounded engineering-assistance examples rather than as autonomous production facts.

GitHub's Copilot agent workflow creates pull-request output and explicitly instructs users to review the resulting code changes as they would any contributor's pull request before approving and merging, supporting the candidate's separation of generation from merge approval.

OpenAI's Evals API defines evaluations using testing criteria plus a data-source schema and supports running evals against model configurations, supporting the candidate's recommendation to keep representative evaluation data and graders repeatable across model or prompt changes.

NIST AI 600-1 is a Generative AI Profile for the AI Risk Management Framework intended to incorporate trustworthiness considerations into the design, development, use, and evaluation of generative-AI systems, supporting the candidate's recommendation to keep AI deployment inside explicit evaluation, control, and risk-management boundaries.
